title: Redux Fundamentals
description: Learn the core concepts of Redux including store, actions, and reducers.
longDescription: This module introduces the foundational concepts of Redux: the single source of truth, state as read-only, and pure function reducers. You'll understand why Redux exists, how its unidirectional data flow works, and why immutability is critical. By the end, you'll be comfortable with the mental model that underpins every Redux application.
whatYouLearn: Create a Redux store with createStore
